findings.desc: dead code: run-pilot-selfcheck.mjs:49 imports mkdirSync from node:fs but never calls it directly in the outer selfcheck module — it only appears inside a string literal (the generated stub host script at lines 132/140). The outer import is unused.

edge: run-pilot-selfcheck.mjs:324 hardcodes snapshotRelPaths as a 3-element list for the byte-identity check in case (6). This list is derived from buildSnapshotFiles() keys in snapshot-builder.mjs, but the selfcheck does not call buildSnapshotFiles() to get the authoritative file set. If snapshot-builder.mjs ever adds a new snapshot file, case (6) will silently under-check byte identity for the new file while the outer hash verification still works.
